Last month, OpenAI launched the first batch of GPT-6 models. Today, the company announced the rollout of new GPT-6 models designed for everyday ChatGPT conversations, alongside the debut of an all-new Intelligent UI. Details below.

ChatGPT Welcomes GPT-6 and Intelligent UI

OpenAI announced today that GPT-6 Sol will be rolled out to ChatGPT Plus, Pro, Business, and Enterprise subscribers, while GPT-6 Luna will begin reaching Free and Go users starting tomorrow.

According to OpenAI, this batch of GPT-6 models has been fine-tuned for everyday conversation and introduces Intelligent UI, a brand-new feature that enables ChatGPT to dynamically combine text, images, and interactive elements based on the content of questions and answers.

Here is OpenAI's introduction:

With Intelligent UI, responses can include images, clickable buttons, forms, charts, and interactive experiences that can be used directly within the conversation. The format depends on what you're asking: side-by-side layouts may work best for comparisons; interactive diagrams can make explanations easier to grasp; and when a simple text answer is most useful, ChatGPT can deliver that too.

In today's official blog post, OpenAI showcased how different prompts can produce responses with different visual aids.

For more complex prompts, ChatGPT can generate interactive widgets, allowing users to explore concepts or adjust inputs to see how the results change.

ChatGPT can now also build interactive tools directly within the conversation, such as calculators, AA bill-splitting tools, and games. OpenAI also noted that with GPT-6, ChatGPT can begin to think while responding, progressively adding information while continuing to reason, rather than waiting for the entire reasoning process to complete before replying all at once.
